title: Alessandra Ginante (Brazilian board director) on the mainstage keynote — 'os conselheiros realmente agregam valor?'
summary: A Brazilian board director who flew in for the Summit records the two questions Eric put to the room — whether directors actually add value, and which kind of director CEOs and their leadership teams genuinely want — and calls them worth reflecting on. She bought the book at the conference to read on the flight home.
blockquote: No palco principal, Eric Ries  foi bastante provocador: os conselheiros realmente agregam valor? Que perfil de conselheiro os presidentes e suas equipes de liderança mais apreciam? Perguntas que merecem reflexão.

type_metadata.translation: On the mainstage, Eric Ries was particularly provocative: do directors really add value? What kind of directors do CEOs and their leadership teams most appreciate? Questions worth reflecting on.
